# Tools overview (generated)

> Generated by `npm run docs:generate:tools` from the registered tool definitions. Do not edit by hand.

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `tower_adopt` | Reconcile the roster with the durable subagent catalog after a restart or new session. Agents that are provably gone are marked retired (records are kept) or missing (retireMissing:false, so the tower can inspect/take over); agents whose parent catalog cannot be read stay unknown and are never changed. Only the tower may adopt. |
| `tower_batch` | Manage finite evidence batches: create freezes missionIds/requiredChecks/receiptPaths, status summarizes members, close verifies every required check and receipt hash, abandon retires a stale open batch. Membership and exclusions are immutable after create; close/abandon never remove missions. |
| `tower_complete` | Worker-only: report mission completion. Enforced by the store: every task done or dropped, no blockers, the current owner, the mission branch has at least one commit since its spawn base, and no unread inbox messages. checks records verifiable evidence (name/command/exitCode/evidence); gates.requireChecks can require at least one before merge. Stores the full report, capped at gates.maxReportBytes (default 32768 UTF-8 bytes); a larger report is rejected with invalid-argument and an actionable nextAction, never truncated. Persists reportBytes on the stored report. completion means ready for preflight and optional review, not merged. |
| `tower_diff` | Read-only view of a mission branch for review: merge base, changed files, commits, and a capped patch against the recorded base. Safe for reviewers; it never modifies the repository. |
| `tower_doctor` | Read-only environment and repository health check: git, state schema, case-sensitivity detection (caseInsensitive and the active scope comparison mode), config, presets/subagents/HMR, the state lock age/heartbeat freshness, workspace lock, roster staleness, worktree ownership, test discovery, leases, and the terminal-mission archive (count, bytes, years, unreadable diagnostics and the configured afterDays/maxMissions policy). Returns checks with pass/warn/fail, a state-lock report and an environment contract. Never writes state and never probes the filesystem. |
| `tower_finding` | File a structured finding (bug / improve / vuln / idea) for the tower to route. Use this for anything notable OUTSIDE your mission scope instead of editing out-of-scope files. Severity is one of low|medium|high|critical. Use tower_findings to list, read, or close findings later. |
| `tower_findings` | List, read, or update findings for a repository. Without id it lists findings newest-first with counts by status (filters: status, type, severity, missionId, open, limit). With id it returns that finding; with id plus status and/or note it records a lifecycle transition. Statuses are open -> triaged -> fixed|wontfix, and fixed/wontfix can be reopened to open. Only the tower or a worker may change a finding; reviewers may only list and read. Read-only when no id is given. |
| `tower_import_legacy` | Read-only import of a Tower Codex (schemaVersion 1) or DSH legacy state file. Stores the full payload under <common>/dsh-tower/legacy/<sha256>.json and records only a summary in state.legacySnapshots; never activates, adopts, or resumes paused missions. |
| `tower_inbox` | Read your tower inbox: messages addressed to you plus broadcasts, newest first. Only returned messages are acknowledged; the result reports unreadRemaining, so keep reading until it reaches 0. Set include_read for history. Unread messages block tower_complete. |
| `tower_init` | Initialize Tower mission state for a repository (absolute repoRoot). Creates <git-common-dir>/dsh-tower/state.json and an activity log; idempotent on an existing workspace. Probes whether the checkout filesystem folds case and records caseInsensitive once, so scope matching follows the real filesystem (a skipped probe records null and keeps the safe case-sensitive comparison). Options: autoGitInit (git init + empty initial commit when the directory is not a repository), snapshotDirty (snapshot uncommitted work into a dangling commit used as the mission baseline), reanchor (change base when every mission is merged/abandoned). Only the tower may initialize. |
| `tower_interrupt` | Interrupt one running tower roster agent (worker or reviewer) and record it as interrupted in the roster. Only the tower may interrupt. Idempotent: an agent that is not running returns interrupted:false. Use it before takeover after a runaway worker, or to stop work that is no longer wanted. |
| `tower_legacy_map` | Audit-only mapping between a legacy snapshot id and a current mission. map records sourceHash/oldId/newMissionId; status lists mappings. Mapping never adopts or resumes a legacy mission. |
| `tower_merge` | Merge a mission branch into the recorded base branch with --no-ff, after the hard gate passes. Verifies the two merge parents and records the mission as merged. If the merge commit already landed (manual merge, crashed or slow pre-merge hook), it detects the merge commit and records it as reconciled instead of merging again. A failed gate returns stable blocker codes without merging; a hook failure aborts cleanly and returns "merge-hook-failed" while a real content conflict returns "merge-conflict". |
| `tower_mission` | Update one mission: lifecycle status, decision note, blocker, clear blockers, mark a task done, drop a task with a reason, or widen the scope (tower only). "merged" is never set here; only a future tower_merge records it. Merged and abandoned are terminal. |
| `tower_plan` | Plan one or more missions in an initialized repository. Each mission has a printable-Unicode title (NFC-normalized, at most 120 characters), relative scope globs, optional task checklist, optional mission-id dependencies, and kind build|survey. Assigns M1.. ids and auto-adds a dependency when build scopes overlap (serializes merges); rejects dependency cycles. |
| `tower_preflight` | Read-only merge gate for one mission: returns ok plus stable blocker codes (branch-missing, deps-unmerged, read-only-survey, stale-base, out-of-scope, base-dirty, branch-owned-by-closed-missions, and mission/worker guards). Review blockers (no-review, review-hold, not-clean, review-not-approved, tip-moved, review-mission-mismatch) apply only when review.requireReview is on. Never changes anything. |
| `tower_rebase` | Rebase a mission branch onto the current base tip inside its own worktree. Refuses while its worker is running or the worktree is dirty. A clean conflict-free rebase waives re-review for the old review; a conflict is aborted and the mission is marked blocked. If the branch is already contained in the base, it returns alreadyMerged and leaves the branch untouched so tower_merge can record the landed merge. |
| `tower_recover` | Read-only recovery diagnostics and an explicit stale-state-lock repair. status reports the state lock owner with its age, heartbeat age and staleness; clear-stale-lock requires confirm:"CLEAR_STALE_LOCK" and only moves a lock whose PID is provably dead to a backup file. force:true additionally clears a live-but-silent PID (a recycled PID) and still renames the record to a .recovered-<ts> backup. It never resets Tower state or worktrees. |
| `tower_reload` | Dev-only: ask DSH HMR to reconcile this profile and reload the Tower Host plugin from disk. The reload is scheduled a few milliseconds after this call returns (so the result reaches the model first). Use after editing the plugin source in a linked profile; plugin_manager install/update already triggers reconciliation by itself. Registered while dev.hotReload is on; fails with reload-unavailable when the HMR service is absent. |
| `tower_resource` | Advisory resource leases per repository (coordination only; no OS CPU/memory hard cap). acquire/release require a token and are tower-only; status is read-only. Expired leases are never taken over silently. |
| `tower_review` | Submit an independent review verdict for a completed mission, bound to the current branch tip. status is "clean", "p1-Nitems", or "p2-Nitems"; merge is "merge", "fix-then-merge", or "hold" (only clean + merge is later approval). Non-clean returns the mission to active. Reviewers are capped at 5 rounds per branch; a tower-submitted review is break-glass and requires breakGlassReason. |
| `tower_roster` | List tower roster agents with authoritative live activity from the subagent catalog (running/inactive/missing/unknown). Read-only; never resumes children. Use before completion or merge decisions. |
| `tower_send` | Send a durable inbox message to a tower participant: a roster agent name, "tower", or "all" (broadcast). The message is persisted first; when the recipient is a currently running roster agent the tower also steers it into that child's current turn. Returns delivery results. |
| `tower_spawn` | Spawn a worker or reviewer for a mission. Workers use the tower-worker preset; reviewers require a completed mission and use the read-only tower-reviewer preset. Provisions (or reuses) the mission git worktree and branch, generates a self-contained briefing, and starts a background subagent in that worktree. The child final report is delivered back to this session; tower_roster shows authoritative activity. Records the agent in the roster; reviewer spawns record the branch tip so a reviewer that modifies the branch cannot submit a review. Returns immediately unless wait=true. |
| `tower_status` | Read the Tower dashboard for a repository: state path, base branch, revision, mission status counts, paged mission summaries (scope/deps/tasks/worktree/owner), roster size, findings, archive count, config path and the activity tail. Pass missionId for one full mission (tasks, notes, reviews, findings, completion report; archived missions are loaded from their year file); offset/limit page the mission list (default 20, max 100); includeGate adds preflight gate digests for the page; includeArchived appends compact archived summaries after the active page; format:"markdown" returns the human-readable mission board (active missions plus an archived count). Read-only. |
| `tower_teardown` | Tear down eligible mission worktrees after their missions are merged or abandoned. A worktree whose roster agent is running is always kept (force cannot override); dirty worktrees need force; exclude keeps named missions. dry_run previews the remove/keep decisions without changing anything. Terminal missions whose worktree is gone and whose configured archive policy is due (archive.afterDays / archive.maxMissions) are moved to <git-common-dir>/dsh-tower/archive/ so state.json stops rewriting them; nothing is deleted. |
| `tower_test` | Run the mission worktree's declared tower.testDiscovery (package.json) and record the receipt. Returns ok:false with diagnostics when discovery fails; does not change mission status. Use tower_complete for automatic admission checks. |
